_about: Department of the Navy, Bureau of Naval Personnel, "State Summary of War Casualties from World War II for Navy, Marine Corps, and Coast Guard Personnel from California, 1946", NARA NAID 305189, https://catalog.archives.gov/id/305189; the National Archives' page for it, with links to every page image: https://www.archives.gov/research/military/ww2/navy-casualties/california.html.
